description: Cloudflare provides a cloud platform offering web security, content delivery network (CDN), DDoS mitigation, and serverless edge computing services.
auth_notes: Authenticate using Bearer tokens or API keys via Authorization headers, or OAuth2 client flows.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free account and generate API tokens or keys self-serve via the Cloudflare dashboard.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST and GraphQL APIs covering user management, DNS, zones, Workers AI, analytics, and security settings.
mcp_notes: Cloudflare officially publishes and maintains multiple MCP servers, including the Cloudflare API MCP Server (mcp.cloudflare.com) and various domain-specific servers.
rationale: Cloudflare features a fully documented broad public API, free self-serve account/token creation, and official vendor-published MCP servers.

evidence.note: Describes creating API tokens and authenticating requests using Bearer tokens.
Shows self-serve token generation steps in the Cloudflare dashboard.
Documents the broad Cloudflare API surface across accounts, zones, DNS, and AI features.
Official Cloudflare repository documenting official remote MCP servers.
